messages:
emma (sales): Hey team — NovaHealth POC ready to convert. They want the order form + DPA signed. Key asks from their procurement: Net30 PO, KMS attestation (customer-managed), EU data residency (eu-west-1), and SAML SSO. Can legal and finance advise on redline tolerance and signature flow? Need to close this week if possible.

raj (legal): Thanks — please drop the customer's redline PDF here. High-level: we can usually accept PO + countersigned order form for Net30 billing. DPA redlines: minor edits ok, anything carving out our breach notification timelines or wholesale deletion exceptions will need tighter review. Who will hold keys for KMS?

sasha (solutions): FYI the POC spent the initial credit pool; if we convert to paid trial we can give a promotional 1-month credit. Pricing for the POC SKU is below.

sasha (solutions): ```
product: redwood-hosted-inference
sku: POC-STD-1
term: 1 month trial then month-to-month
billing_contact: billing@novahealth.com
price_per_token: $0.0009
promo_credit: $5,000 (applied at first invoice)
```

maria (finance): Net30 is OK from finance, but we need the formal PO number before we invoice. Also need billing contact and remit instructions on the signed order form. If they want ACH/wire, include bank details template. We prefer PO placed against the orderform line item.

emma (sales): @raj I uploaded their redline PDF (filename: Nova_POC_Orderform_Redline_2026-03-18.pdf). They stripped our indemnity and added a subprocessor list requirement. @maria their procurement says PO will be issued today if we accept KMS attestation language.

raj (legal): Opening the redline now. Quick notes: we can narrow indemnity language to mutual indemnity with carveouts; subprocessor list is negotiable if we commit to notice + written subprocessor approval process. For KMS we need to see attestation details. We can draft an addendum for KMS custody terms.

oliver (security): For KMS/customer-managed keys: we require a written attestation that keys will not be shared, and a technical runbook for key rotation. If Nova wants HSM-backed keys we need SSAE-type attestation. Otherwise we can offer our managed KMS with separation of duties.

raj (legal): Signature routing — two options: 1) Standard DocuSign envelope: sales uploads signed orderform + MSA reference, we countersign via DocuSign. 2) If they insist on PDF redline with wet-ink PO, we need coordinate with ops for manual countersign and audit. Preference: DocuSign for speed. Which does Nova prefer?

emma (sales): They prefer DocuSign. I can assemble the envelope once legal confirms final language. @raj can you draft the KMS addendum text we discussed? Small bullets should do.

raj (legal): I'll draft a short KMS addendum and a DPA response matrix (what we accept vs what needs escalation). Expect initial draft in ~3 hours. :thumbsup:

maria (finance): Once we have the signed DocuSign envelope and PO #, I'll raise the billing account and issue first invoice (Net30). If they request invoicing to multiple entities, ping me with entity detail.

docsign-bot: Envelope created by emma (sales) draft-2345 (status: draft) :eyes:

emma (sales): Great — I'll wait on raj's addendum and then send the envelope. If anyone has a hard blocker on the indemnity or subprocessor language please flag now.

oliver (security): No blockers from security on indemnity changes so long as breach notification remains <=72 hours and we keep the ability to terminate on critical findings.

raj (legal): Noted. If anyone needs me to jump on a short call with Nova procurement to negotiate live let me know. I can do 4pm PT today.

emma (sales): I'll schedule the 4pm PT call and share the calendar invite. Thanks everyone. :sunglasses:
